review_candidates.title: Quality Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Quality Software Engineer 5+ Years Experience Role Overview We are seeking a Quality Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience to contribute to the quality engineering of enterprise-grade AI and SaaS products. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in manual testing, test automation, API testing, database testing, and regression testing . The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, and QA teams to understand requirements, design effective test scenarios, identify defects, improve test coverage, and support high-quality software releases. Experience in product engineering, SaaS applications, AI/ML-driven applications, data-intensive platforms, or regulated software will be an advantage. Key Responsibilities 1. Functional & Manual Testing Strong understanding of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) . Create and execute test scenarios, test cases, and test plans based on product requirements. Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, usability, integration, and acceptance testing . Analyze requirements and identify functional gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and potential quality risks . Execute tests across different environments and configurations. Log, track, retest, and close defects using JIRA or similar defect management tools . Perform root-cause analysis of defects in collaboration with developers. Participate in requirement reviews, story grooming, sprint planning, and release activities . Work closely with developers and Product teams to ensure defects are resolved within the required timelines. 2. Automation Testing Hands-on experience in UI and API test automation . Experience with automation frameworks/tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar technologies . Good programming/scripting knowledge in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript . Develop, execute, and maintain reusable and maintainable automation scripts . Identify suitable test cases for automation and contribute to improving automation coverage . Troubleshoot and analyze automation failures. Experience with headless browser testing is preferred. Understanding of parallel test execution is an advantage. Basic experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Experience with Git, Bitbucket, or similar version-control tools . Knowledge of BDD frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow is an advantage. 3. API Testing Hands-on experience in REST API testing using tools such as Postman . Validate API responses, status codes, request/response parameters, headers, and error handling. Test positive, negative, boundary, and error scenarios . Validate API integration with databases and downstream services. Basic understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth. Experience creating and maintaining API automation tests is preferred. 4. Data & Database Testing Good hands-on experience with SQL and database testing . Experience with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra . Ability to write SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, and integrity checks . Validate data across different application layers and services. Experience testing data transformation, migration, and data consistency . Understanding of ETL/data pipelines and data lake concepts is an advantage. Ability to identify and troubleshoot data-related defects . 5. Performance & Non-Functional Testing Understanding of performance, load, stress, reliability, and scalability testing . Hands-on experience with JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Exposure to BlazeMeter or cloud-based performance testing is an advantage. Ability to analyze response time, throughput, latency, and performance trends . Basic understanding of identifying performance bottlenecks . Exposure to monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, or Splunk . Understanding of test data generation and parameterization for performance testing. Basic understanding of performance testing in cloud environments . 6. Security Testing Good understanding of web application security concepts and the OWASP Top 10 . Hands-on or working experience with Burp Suite and/or OWASP ZAP . Experience with basic API security testing . Understanding of authentication, authorization, JWT, and OAuth . Ability to identify, document, and track security vulnerabilities. Work with development teams to validate security fixes and remediation . Knowledge of secure coding and application security principles is an advantage. 7. AI/ML & Product Testing Experience or interest in testing AI/ML-driven applications . Ability to validate AI-driven functionality from a functional, data, and usability perspective . Validate different input scenarios, edge cases, and unexpected inputs. Understand and test application behavior when AI-generated results are involved. Experience with data-intensive applications is an advantage. Ability to understand complex product workflows and business rules. 8. Quality Engineering & Collaboration Work collaboratively with Developers, Product Managers, Business Analysts, DevOps, and QA teams . Contribute to improving test coverage, automation coverage, and overall product quality . Identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle. Participate in code/story reviews from a quality perspective . Ensure appropriate testing is completed before releases. Maintain clear documentation of test results, defects, and quality risks . Follow defined quality, testing, security, and documentation standards . Contribute ideas for continuous improvement of QA processes and automation . Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field . 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering. Strong hands-on experience in manual and automation testing . Experience testing web applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems . Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments . Good experience with JIRA or similar defect/test management tools . Experience working closely with cross-functional product engineering teams . Skills & Attributes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills . Good understanding of requirements, business workflows, and data models . Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset . Ability to independently analyze requirements and design effective test scenarios. Good understanding of manufacturing processes is preferred. Functional understanding of ERP systems and data models is an advantage. Exposure to CSV, GxP, or other regulated environments is a plus. Experience with AI/ML applications or data-heavy platforms is an advantage. Good communication and collaboration skills . Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment . Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve testing and automation practices . About Mareana Mareana builds cutting-edge enterprise digital AI products focused on Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Sustainability. Our AI-driven platforms solve complex data challenges and deliver real-time insights, enabling businesses to accelerate digital transformation. We have delivered more than $1B+ in business value to global clients, including leading firms in life sciences, consumer goods, chemicals, food & beverage, and manufacturing. We are recognized by Gartner as a “Cool Vendor in AI” and have been featured in Silicon Review and Manufacturing Insights. Our leadership team includes experts from leading global pharma and tech companies, with backgrounds from IIT, NYU, UC Berkeley, UCLA, and others.

review_candidates.description: CHI SIAMO AGAP2 è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa, parte del Gruppo Moongy. Siamo presenti in 14 Paesi europei con oltre 10.000 dipendenti e continuiamo a crescere grazie a persone che condividono i nostri valori. Operiamo in una realtà in costante evoluzione, dove le relazioni umane sono sempre al centro. Ruolo: Full Stack Developer Modalità di lavoro: Full remote Siamo alla ricerca di un Full Stack Developer da inserire all'interno di un'azienda partner. La risorsa sarà coinvolta nella progettazione, sviluppo e manutenzione di applicazioni web full stack, con un focus specifico su soluzioni low-code sviluppate in ambiente OutSystems. L'attività comprenderà lo sviluppo di applicazioni front-end e back-end, API e Web Services, integrazione con database, testing e rilascio in produzione. REQUISITI: Esperienza consolidata con la piattaforma OutSystems . Solida esperienza di sviluppo backend in Java . Solida esperienza di sviluppo frontend con Angular/React. Esperienza nello sviluppo e nell'integrazione di REST API / Web Services. Conoscenza di database SQL. Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (mandatoria) e buona conoscenza dell'inglese. 3 o + anni di esperienza nel ruolo. COMPETENZE: Sviluppo low-code/no-code su piattaforma OutSystems. Sviluppo backend con Java. Sviluppo frontend con Angular. Sviluppo e integrazione di REST API / Web Services. Gestione e integrazione di database SQL e NoSQL. Implementazione e utilizzo di pipeline CI/CD. NICE TO HAVE: Certificazione OutSystems. COSA OFFRIAMO: contratto a tempo indeterminato; strumenti di formazione sia per le hard che soft skill; follow-up costanti con il team HR e con il proprio Business Manager; un piano di crescita professionale in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante. La retribuzione annua per questo ruolo è compresa tra 30.000 EUR e 35.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società . Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna The world needs you AGAP2 è un equal opportunities employer : crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99.
